description: A playable two-octave piano in your browser — click keys or use your computer keyboard.

faqs.a: Oscillators with a piano-like envelope, synthesized live with the Web Audio API.
faqs.q: How are the piano sounds made?

faqs.a: The bottom letter row: A plays C, W plays C#, S plays D, and so on across two octaves.
C4 to B5 — two full octaves.

howto: Click the piano keys with your mouse.
Or play with your computer keyboard (A–K row).
Adjust the volume slider to taste.
title: Piano Keyboard
